title: Cartier-Miller congruence experiment: truncated central-binomial sums S_k(z)
target: S_k(z) = sum_{i=0}^{floor((p-1)/k)} binom(2i,i) z^i mod p, computed as T_f(1), f = 1 - 4 z x^k (Corollary 4.2)
round2_stratify_by_legendre_of: odd primes l != 3 dividing numerator/denominator of z or 1-4z

definitions.u: p = u^2 + s^2, u odd, u = 1 mod 4

discovery.dependency_pruning: before each run, relations among basis columns alone with sup-norm <= H and gap >= gap_factor are removed by dropping the last involved element; logged

confirmation.rule: a candidate is confirmed only if it holds at every confirmation prime; candidates are frozen (SHA-256) before confirmation

stage0.confirmation_size_check: 2 primes per class and k at each confirmation size: CM data identities, cube/4th roots of unity, Fermat quotient, and target evaluation without trace ambiguity
stage0.pass_rule: zero mismatches; every planted relation recovered exactly; no candidate from random targets; no failures at confirmation sizes

stopping_rule: stop when Round 1 and Round 2 are exhausted or after 8 hours of compute; a confirmed relation ends the search for that target; no unregistered additions (new ideas go to a separately frozen Round 3)
